connection.R29vZ2xlRG9jdW1lbnRBaVJlc3RDb.source: Location of a GCP service-account or authorized-user JSON file; processed with `FileLocationHandler::getTextFileFromLocation()`, so it may be a bare path or any registered scheme (ex: `file:///etc/gcp/sa.json`, `http(s)://`, `sftp://`).  When omitted, Application Default Credentials are used.
